Keep the same design, colours, proportions and painted style as the reference. 1024x1024, flat plain white background, character facing right, full body, feet near the bottom edge, no text, no letters, no logos.
cards.foot/warden-run-b: Painted cyberpunk Frankfurt 2099, hand-painted game art, rain, teal and magenta neon, readable silhouettes, crisp dark outline, chunky shapes that read at small size. Same character as the reference (Warden, corporate enforcer (boss)), running, the OPPOSITE stride to the first running frame: back leg passing under the body, other leg bent up (passing frame of a run cycle), leaning forward. Keep the same design, colours, proportions and painted style as the reference. 1024x1024, flat plain white background, character facing right, full body, feet near the bottom edge, no text, no letters, no logos.
cards.foot/warden-shoot: Painted cyberpunk Frankfurt 2099, hand-painted game art, rain, teal and magenta neon, readable silhouettes, crisp dark outline, chunky shapes that read at small size. Same character as the reference (Warden, corporate enforcer (boss)), leaning forward and firing a gold energy bolt from the blade held out, flash at the tip. Keep the same design, colours, proportions and painted style as the reference. 1024x1024, flat plain white background, character facing right, full body, feet near the bottom edge, no text, no letters, no logos.
